record.title: The Pale Harvest
record.premise: The Voh-Vastei swims out from Ysan's jetty to the wreck of the Pale Harvest, gets past its drowned crew to the captain's strongbox, and brings Nesh-Deeka the Kothringi keystone inside.
record.foundation: Built from main-plot.md §5 quest 7. Kept: the wreck in shallow water off Ysan's jetty past slaughterfish, air in the hull (Katariah's hold interior, entered by a door in the hull), the drowned crew in the hold and the captain beside his strongbox, the three ways (fight, steal past and pick, the key from the captain), the Kothringi keystone on a chain, and Nesh-Deeka sending the player to the Chime-Keepers of Toklea. Filled: the strongbox's lock (Adept), the captain's key taken from his body (a draugr cannot be pickpocketed), and what Nesh-Deeka already knows (that the Unbound have not yet found the wreck; they lost the trail at Gideon).

truth.what: The Pale Harvest ran onto a sandbar with a Gideon dealer's stock aboard; her captain locked the dealer's best piece, a Kothringi keystone on a chain, in his own strongbox.
The drowned crew rose as the walking dead; air stayed in the hull.

stages.journalText: Nesh-Deeka sent me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight, a short swim out from Ysan's jetty. I'm to get into the hold, where the drowned crew walk, and open the captain's strongbox. I may fight them or steal past and pick its lock; the captain carries its key.
stages.directions: Poles-Upriver's boats run from Helstrom's landing down the rivers to Archon and on round the coast to Thorn. From Thorn's quay walk south along the coast to Ysan's stone jetty, then swim east past the slaughterfish to the listing hull; its door lets into the hold.

stages.journalText: Nesh-Deeka did not know the keystone, but it is of Kothringi make, and the Chime-Keepers of Toklea keep what is left of Kothringi lore. She already knew the Unbound had not found the wreck. When I asked how, she said "we listen" and talked of Toklea instead. She paid me 100 gold.

information.going: The keystone is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers of Toklea may know what it opens. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had or had not been.

topics.label: How do I reach the Pale Harvest?
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: Poles-Upriver's boats to Archon and round the coast to Thorn; walk south from Thorn to Ysan, a landing of stone-cutters with a dry-stone jetty; the wreck lies a short swim out, with slaughterfish about it. Does: nothing.

topics.label: I found this keystone in the captain's strongbox.
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: she does not know it, but the carving is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, a town on the river fork in the Tulmek Washes, keep what is left of Kothringi lore; their elder will know. Then she says the Unbound have not been to the wreck: they lost the trail at Gideon. Does: nothing (a question; its answer is topic.mn07-how-know).

topics.label: How can you know where the Unbound have not been?
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: "We listen." She turns to Toklea and pays 100 gold. Does: sets stage 90.

topics.label: Who were the Kothringi?
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: a people of silver-skinned men and women who lived in the marsh beside the Argonians; the Knahaten Flu killed every one of them in the Second Era; Argonians who lived through it settled their empty towns, and Toklea kept their name and their chimes. Does: nothing.

topics.label: Who are the Chime-Keepers?
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: the people of Toklea, who hang tin and copper chimes from every eave as the Kothringi did and keep their stories; an elder speaks for them in the old Kothringi greathouse. Does: nothing.

findings.finding: Kothringi died of the Knahaten Flu; Toklea resettled.

answers: I work for handler Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka. I am hunting the real Eye of Argonia, which is meant to heal the Hist trees at the Root. The Old Silver Setting led me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter in Hatandros Bight. The Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) are also after the Eye.
Get into the wreck, past the drowned crew, and open the captain's strongbox.
Fight the Drowned Captain and Drowned Sailor and take the key from the captain, or sneak past and pick the strongbox lock. I favour fighting.
I do not know what the strongbox holds, or why the crew are drowned and walking. I could find out by looking inside the wreck.

answers: The quest is done. I got the Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest and gave it to Nesh-Deeka. She did not know it, but she says it is Kothringi make. She paid me 100 gold (the game shows it added twice). She says the Unbound have not been to the wreck, but she would not say how she knows: "we listen."
The next lead is Toklea, on the river fork in the Tulmek Washes. The Chime-Keepers there keep Kothringi lore and their elder should know the keystone.
I can go to Toklea. I can also ask Nesh-Deeka about the Kothringi and the Chime-Keepers first.
I do not know who the Kothringi were, what the keystone opens, or how Nesh-Deeka knows what the Unbound do. I can ask her the Kothringi and Chime-Keepers topics, or ask the elder in Toklea.

state.notes: I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka under Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. At the Pale Harvest wreck I killed the Drowned Captain, took his key and opened the strongbox. It held a Kothringi Keystone, which I still carry along with the Pale Harvest Strongbox Key, the Old Silver Setting, The Collector note and the smuggler key. I have about 600 gold after Nesh-Deeka paid me 100. She does not know the keystone, but she says it is Kothringi. The Chime-Keepers of Toklea, on the river fork in the Tulmek Washes, keep Kothringi lore, and their elder should know it. She says the Unbound have not found the wreck, but she will not say how she knows ("we listen"). The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) and the Unbound are still hunting the Eye. I have not yet asked her about the Kothringi or the Chime-Keepers. Next step: go to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder.

know_text: I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka under handler Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The Eye of Argonia on sale in Gideon (dealer Ovinius Calo) was cheap glass. I killed the smugglers at Gideon South Watch and took the Old Silver Setting, which I still carry along with The Collector note and the smuggler key. Inside the band is scratched the name Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight, east coast south of Thorn, with a Gideon dealers whole stock aboard. That is the next lead for the real Eye. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold (I have about 400 or more). The Unbound (Cuts-the-Old-Knot) also hunt the Eye, and two asked about the glass in Gideon a month ago. Ennodius Vanin, the Collector, an Imperial relic-hunter, also hunts it. Nesh-Deeka will not say how she knew about the Unbound ("we listen"). The Eye is meant to be used at the Root to heal the Hist trees. Next: travel to Hatandros Bight and find the wreck.
